svg.title: Kapitsa: inside the inference engine
svg.desc: Kapitsa's architecture, top to bottom along one request beam. 01: coding agents and API clients reach one HTTP surface (OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses, Anthropic Messages); the engine renders the Jinja chat template, tokenizes with byte-level BPE, picks a slot and reuses the longest cached prefix, with attention KV and recurrent-state checkpoints per conversation, and images through a ViT. 02: the Qwen35 backend (Gated DeltaNet and gated attention, 3 to 1) or the NemotronH backend (Mamba-2, LatentMoE and attention) prefills the rest in chunks on the GPU and the Neural Engine. 03: a block drafter (DFlash2 or LiLiCorr) proposes 7 tokens, the target verifies 8 rows in one pass, accepted tokens commit and stream back as API deltas. 04: Metal kernels, the Neural Engine and unified memory. 05: the model store.
svg.text: Raw Metal and C++20 for Qwen3.5-family and Nemotron-H models
on Apple silicon. No MLX or llama.cpp runtime.
one request on the GPU at a time
SSE: reasoning · content · tool calls; the
pre-split: Qwen's + NFC · Tekken's on Bolt
the reasoning effort goes to the template
wins; a new conversation takes, in order:
its own KV cache and recurrent state
image rows keyed by SHA-256 of their pixels
resume: live state or the nearest checkpoint
attention KV: grown on demand, never snapshotted
through tool loops) and the newest one
the drafter's ring is snapshotted with each
after a reply, the history prefills while idle
CPU: digest; Qwen smart_resize, Bolt patch budget
layers DFlash2 captures for its K/V ring
attention: GQA, head dim 256, RoPE on 64 dims
DeltaNet: conv1d + delta rule, fp32 state
blocks LiLiCorr captures for its K/V ring
sigmoid router + correction bias: top-9 of
weights as stored: NVFP4 · IQ2_XXS · Q8_0 · BF16
dense FFN: 512-channel units split per chip
GPU: its share in the model's format · ANE:
two row halves: the ANE's FFN of one hides
under the GPU's mixer of the other (dashed:
the GPU's own FFN share, often none)
ANE: 70% of each Mamba-2 in/out projection
and the shared expert, beside the GPU's
routed experts; int8 after Hadamard rotations
in the background; GPU alone till ready
watchdog; a failed chunk reruns on GPU
released to the KV cache under pressure
one pass: anchor + 7 mask rows → 7 tokens
top-16 per row from a reduced LM head,
a rank-256 transition lattice, then a walk
MTP head: the Qwen fallback, fixed depth
8 rows in one target pass (a chain, not a tree)
8×8 MMAs read each weight row once for all 8;
MoE reads each touched expert once
DFlash2: rejection sampling, u·q < p, else
resample max(0, p − q); LiLiCorr keeps drafts
4 drafts accepted + the target's token at the miss = 5 tokens
KV rows already sit at their positions
DeltaNet rollback tape: accepted rows fold in
as rank-1 updates, rejected ones never do
Mamba-2: the next scan replays accepted rows
the drafter rings commit the kept rows; DFlash2
queues the next draft behind this verify
compiled at runtime from embedded source
